steps: Attach the X and A axes to the same logical machine
Check the logical machine assignment of the X and A axes
Ensure the attach command is used correctly in the program
Detach the x' axis from logical machine 2
Check the current logical machine attachment of the x' axis
Restart the part program processor
Verify the x' axis is not attached to any logical machine
Verify the axis is not assigned to an ordinate used on another logical machine
Verify the axis is not a soft axis
Check the axis index is valid and not in use elsewhere
Verify the logical machine numbers are correctly configured
Verify the part program 'm101.pp' exists in the configured search hierarchy.
Check the search hierarchy path for any typos or incorrect folder names.
Check the file extension of 'm101.pp' to ensure it is correctly set as '.pp'.
Add at least 3 control points between splineon and splineoff commands.
Check the splineon and splineoff blocks for correct placement of control points.
Verify the spline type is properly specified with at least 3 control points.
Check the block for more than one class 1 preparatory word.
Remove or reorganize class 1 preparatory words to ensure only one is present.
Verify the G-code syntax follows the rule of one class 1 preparatory word per block.
Set the Joint logical device for each joint to a unique logical address.
Check the logical device assignments for conflicts.
Restart the system to apply changes.
Disable the OPC UA server by setting `opcua.enable` to `false`.
Check the license includes the OPC UA server option.
Purchase the OPC UA server option if required.
Verify the OPC UA server is disabled after applying the license.
Restart the system
Reinitialise the EtherCAT bus
Verify the device's operational state matches the Master's expected state
Restart the system to recover from the emergency state.
Reinitialise the Ethercat bus to reset the drive's communication state.
Check the drive's reported error register for additional diagnostic information.
Restart the system
Verify the cyclic task configuration for task 1
Check the drive's reported error register
Check for interference on the EtherCAT network
Verify the EtherCAT master configuration
Check the network topology for correct device addressing
Check the power supply stability for the EtherCAT devices
Upload firmware to device Drive_3 using the --firmware command.
Start AMCore in device mode with the -start device flag.
Verify firmware version matches expected version using --actual-firmware.
Check fieldbus state is INIT or PREOP before uploading.
Run the firmware tool in automatic mode to resolve mismatch.
Reinitialise the fieldbus after firmware upload completes.
Power cycle Drive_3 if firmware version is still not updated.
